frame: The simulation's scene frame (web/src/acoustics/engine/importer.ts): x = Matterport plan x, z = Matterport plan y, y = elevation, metres. The Showcase overlay may mirror z when it draws on the 3D view (alignPolygon); the solver, the grid and the demo sources use this unmirrored frame.
spectrum: spectrumDbAt1m: unweighted sound pressure level at 1 m in the octave bands [63, 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000] Hz.

evidence.source: Hush noise model 0.2.0, overnight block: S Greenhouse Rd level at wall xg384kwe2cs7c69dayf84kudd
evidence.note: A point source stands in for a road (a line source). Spectrum shape assumed: the simulation's own 'road' profile (web/src/acoustics/demo.ts), because no research file gives the band values of the OITC reference transportation spectrum (ASTM E1332) that R3 cites. Only the A-weighted total is the model's.
